response.rationale: The answers are valid, but the national split is materially overstated. Indonesian officially recognizes "tonsil" as an equivalent of "amandel," and Indonesian medical usage also uses "tonsil." Malaysian Malay clearly uses "tonsil." The distinction is therefore a preference/register contrast, not a clean different-word contrast. No false-friend contrast is supported.
